fullDesc: In September 1519 Ferdinand Magellan led five ships from Spain to find a western route to the Spice Islands. Magellan died in the Philippines in 1521, and one ship under Juan Sebastián Elcano completed the first circumnavigation in 1522.
realFacts: Magellan found the strait that now bears his name
The voyage proved how large the Pacific is
Spain gained a claim to Pacific trade
